title: PROGRAM CHANGE -> SOUND
author: irpina
description: A program change on a synth track's MIDI channel (MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) loads that pool sound onto the track, as the SOUND BROWSER's FUNC + YES does: program 1 is pool sound 001, 128 is 128. Such a program change is the mod's: the stock does not also change the pattern for it. Other channels stay the stock's. For the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys, OS 1.43 and 1.44 (it names no firmware address: its 1.44 port is empty). Needs core-dn1 5.0.1.
